Two frat boys were stopped by the cops for creating a ruckus during one particularly loud house party, one Sikh and one Mormon. The Sikh guy was there making sure people people at the party were safe, and his friend, the Mormon guy, came to try and pick up any drunk girls he could find. Who was likely just caught in the wrong place at the wrong time?
A. The Mormon one
B. The Sikh one
C. Can't answer
